newsitem.title: THAILAND: Phatra lends 20 pct to property sector.
newsitem.headline: Phatra lends 20 pct to property sector.

text.p: Phatra Thanakit Plc said on Wednesday its 10 billion baht ($385 million) loan exposure to Thailand's ailing property sector amounted to 20 percent of its outstanding lending.

Phatra Thanakit president Banyong Pongpanich said most of his firm's property loans were backed by collateral with only a small portion turning sour in line with a sluggish Thai economy. He did not elaborate.
Phatra Thanakit chairman Viroj Naulkhair told a news conference his firm had not increased its 700-member staff in the past three years.
He said the company would split its current finance and brokerage business into two firms in the next six months pending approval from the finance ministry.

Viroj said Phatra Thanakit had stopped extending margin loans to retail investors. He said retail investors would decline in number while the bourse remains dominated by institutional investors who currently account for 60 percent of market activity.
Phatra Thanakit's net profit fell to 1.46 billion baht in 1996 from 1.91 billion a year earlier.
